title: GCSE folds the status-mask decrement before allocation
claim: The sub_08028858 candidate loses its retained 0x8000 mask when GCSE propagates its constant into a mask-minus-one operation and folds it to 0x7fff. A narrow constant-return inline provides a diagnostic control through a SUBREG destination; a generic shifted bit constructor does not. This mechanism does not justify adding the constant-return helper to game source or prove that readable matching C is impossible. Further local-variable spelling trials do not address the observed pass transition.
